# Tiferes — Thirty Corrections Before Expansion

The Awtsmoos joins abundance and boundary until the interface breathes in time;
Awtsmoos.com should make technical rigor and human ease reveal the same design.

1. Split any touched source file above the architectural size boundary.
2. Replace compressed callbacks in touched shared-social modules.
3. Preserve every existing public export unless all consumers are migrated.
4. Preserve canonical Social Hub route IDs exactly.
5. Keep external Observatory navigation explicitly external.
6. Keep discovery components mutation-free.
7. Keep mutation handlers injected and observable.
8. Make pending action state keyboard- and screen-reader-visible.
9. Restore disabled state correctly after async actions.
10. Preserve aria-pressed state for toggle-like actions.
11. Prevent duplicate installer ownership per document.
12. Prevent duplicate listener attachment on repeated mounts.
13. Keep all shared selectors rooted beneath `.awtsmoosSocialExperience`.
14. Keep Social Hub-only selectors beneath `.social-hub-document`.
15. Reject accidental `100vw` component sizing.
16. Use dynamic viewport units only with bounded fallbacks where needed.
17. Replace literal z-index escalation with local layer tokens.
18. Respect safe-area insets for fixed mobile UI.
19. Ensure flex/grid children declare `min-inline-size: 0` where text may grow.
20. Keep hover enhancement behind hover-capable media queries.
21. Give every relevant control visible `:focus-visible` and `:active` states.
22. Honor `prefers-reduced-motion` for every new animation.
23. Preserve forced-colors legibility for custom controls.
24. Use textContent or trusted descriptors instead of innerHTML.
25. Keep raw API evidence available after human normalization.
26. Re-read all written files from disk rather than trusting write payloads.
27. Search all touched files for leading-space indentation.
28. Run syntax/import tests only after the coherent code tranche is complete.
29. Browser-test narrow mobile, wide mobile, tablet, and desktop.
30. Convert every planned-versus-actual delta into new remaining work before stopping.
